reviewedRevision: eb44e29 plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-machine shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. Its BLOCKING key conflict and two MEDIUM findings were fixed and verified by re-running the reviewer's own solver, naive-bot and pilot scripts, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: On the final files the reviewer's breadth-first solver found every machine solvable, with mastery machines 15-20 needing 5, 7, 8, 10, 6 and 7 crank turns. A naive bot (walk toward the goal, turn any nearby gear) cleared 1 of 96 runs on machines 15-20. The reviewer's prompt-following pilot, given freshly solved plans and reacting 0.25 s or 0.35 s late, cleared 24 of 24 runs at each delay.

findings.observation: Only 3 machines, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven machines (teaching, combination and mastery tiers) with linked ferries, lift decks, presses and keyed exit doors, accurate EN/ZH tips, a machine select and env.progress continue, and the file is split into six modules.
Review finding: the free rewind was bound to R, which the host reserves for restart. Rewind is now Q, shown on the HUD as 'Q: rewind' and in the controls list, with the touch Rewind button kept.
Review finding: a player who wedged a machine got no prompt. After 20 s without progress the status line now suggests pressing Q to rewind.

Review finding: mastery machines 16-18 were short and machine 14 (Seesaw) had a shortcut. Machines 16 Press Gates, 17 Gate Tower and 18 Gate Ferries were rebuilt to need 7-10 crank turns, and Seesaw's shortcut was closed.

openNotes: Machines are deterministic, so once a plan is known the challenge is planning rather than execution timing.
The stuck hint appears after 20 s even for a player who is deliberately thinking.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened machine 1 of 20 with lives, key state, the 'Q: rewind' HUD label and the gear prompts unobscured.
Win: machine 1 was cleared by keyboard and play advanced to Machine 2/20 Boiler Gate.
Q rewound machine 2 for free: the carried key returned to its start and lives stayed at 5.
English 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the machine select showed machine 1 cleared and 2 unlocked, with touch buttons Left, Right, Jump, Gear, Key and Rewind.
Not covered in the browser: a loss by falling; the quality tests cover it.
